I am a trauma-informed Inner Child Practitioner, holistic guide and mentor supporting individuals to heal, reconnect with their inner wisdom, and live with greater authenticity, emotional freedom and self-trust. My work blends psychology, somatic healing, meditation and energy practices into a grounded, compassionate approach to personal transformation. I hold space with warmth, safety and deep presence, honouring each journey with care and non-judgement.

Our eyes meet, settling for a moment into presence. A conscious breath. A soft smile.

Welcome to my space.

Here, sensitivity, perceptivity and safety are held with intention. I honour feminine divinity and grace in the way I support and guide others, offering compassion, openness and acceptance. My work centres around self-empowerment therapies that help you explore your inner world, heal, attune to your own rhythm and realise a deeper sense of purpose.

My path into this work began with an early fascination for analytical psychology. After completing my Master’s in Investigative Forensic Psychology in London, I followed a natural intrigue into the anthropological and existential aspects of human life; our challenges, potentials, and the deeper meaning of our time here on earth.

This curiosity led me to question what it means to evolve, to live authentically, and to feel free within ourselves. To answer this, I had to turn inward. A deeply heartfelt journey of self-discovery unfolded through yoga, meditation and introspective work. These practices reawakened forms of self-expression that had lay dormant, and helped me recognise new capacities within myself.

My personal practices now contribute directly to the therapies and programs I offer. Working with energy consciously, with intention, direction and awareness, mirrors how I support others: guiding them to cultivate self-empowerment, self-trust, and a stronger connection to their inner wisdom. I serve with gratitude for every soul I meet, and with a reverence for the transformative power of safe, compassionate space.

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="15"][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]
I hold a vision of flourishing — a harmony between internal and external landscapes — where we honour our natural rhythms and flow. Our time together doesn’t just support individual healing; it contributes to a collective evolution that I am devoted to witnessing and nurturing.

My approach is inner-child-led, trauma-informed and integrative, shaped by both professional training and lived experience, and grounded in compassion, presence and relational safety.

My work sits at the meeting point between intuitive, embodied healing and psychological understanding. Rather than viewing these as separate or opposing approaches, I experience them as deeply complementary; each enriching the other when held with care, discernment and integrity.

This perspective is explored more fully in a reflective conversation with a chartered psychologist, where we discuss the compatibility of traditional psychology with intuitive and inner-child-centred therapeutic work, and how this integration can support meaningful, lasting healing.

After graduating with a Master’s Degree in Investigative Forensic Psychology in London, I developed programs and practices that have supported many people through meaningful transformation. I understand that true healing is not limited to therapy alone, it lives in the everyday choices, habits and ways we relate to ourselves.

My approach is holistic, integrating mind, body, intuition and emotional healing. Over the years I’ve trained and worked as an:

  • Inner Child Practitioner
  • Trauma-Informed Integration Specialist
  • Yoga Teacher
  • Meditation Guide
  • Reiki Master
  • Trainer, Mentor and Intuitive Energy Guide

Through workshops, mentoring programs and practitioner trainings, I provide tangible tools, somatic practices and ongoing support for those on journeys of growth, healing and awakening.

My work draws on psychotherapy, cognitive behavioural therapy, NLP, reframing, reparenting, somatic experiencing, breathwork, mindfulness and general wellbeing practices. Every session is tailored to the individual, because each journey is unique.

Freedom: I hold space for personal transformation, a space where authenticity is welcomed and encouraged. You are already whole, and I support the parts of you that are ready to expand, grow, and live with greater freedom and self-expression.

Compassion: With an open heart, I honour the full spectrum of your experience; light, shadow and everything in between. My work is rooted in gentle mindfulness and compassionate awareness, offering a safe container for you to explore, heal and return to yourself.

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="10"][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="center" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="20"][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

Trauma Informed Care: As a trauma-informed practitioner, I honour nervous-system safety, consent-led process and gentle pacing. Our work together unfolds in partnership, nothing is forced. Every feeling, memory and insight is met with compassion and non-judgement. Confidentiality, transparency and emotional safety are central to my practice, and I hold each journey with integrity, care and respect for your boundaries and lived experience.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

Mission Statement: I believe every person is whole, complete and worthy as they are; healing simply reveals what has always been there. Through reconnecting with the inner child, intuition and authentic voice, we soften patterns of protection and return to the rhythm of our true self. My mission is to offer guidance that nurtures self-awareness, resilience and inner freedom, so each individual can live a life aligned with their truth, purpose and heart.

Seeking ongoing personal support
→ Mindset & Wellbeing Coaching
A grounded, trauma-informed space to work with patterns, relationships, and everyday challenges with clarity and compassion.

Feeling called to train or guide others
→ Inner Child Practitioner Training
An experiential pathway for those wishing to embody this work more deeply and share it with integrity.

Reconnect, heal and rediscover your inner child

Meet, reconnect, and heal with your inner child. This online, workshop-style course is designed to help you rediscover the magic, fun, and love of your inner child, while also healing past wounds, trauma, and limiting beliefs. Together, we explore how childhood experiences and self-sabotaging patterns may be influencing your adult life today.

Everyone has the capacity to connect with their inner child. This workshop offers a safe and supportive space to begin building a trusting relationship with that part of yourself. You’ll learn practical tools and techniques that you can continue using in daily life—helping you reclaim authenticity, confidence, play, and emotional wellbeing.

  • 3 x 2-hour live online sessions via Zoom
  • Guidance from an experienced practitioner specialising in inner child healing
  • Guided meditations and playful exercises to explore between sessions
  • All course materials provided through a private online portal

Having worked in therapeutic settings including counselling, psychoanalytical work and trauma-informed care, I bring a diverse toolkit and a flexible, integrative approach to healing. My experience includes supporting individuals with severe trauma (PTSD, childhood abuse and violence), depression, anxiety, dissociative patterns and eating disorders.

Through this work, I have developed gentle and empowering therapies that honour each person’s unique needs and support self-healing. My intention is always to create a safe, compassionate and nurturing space for transformation.

If you feel called to create more harmony, inner confidence and self-understanding, I invite you to connect.

data.post_content:

I’m delighted you landed here" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="fadeInUp" css=""][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="10"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

The journey to becoming a certified Inner Child Practitioner begins with the Inner Child Workshop. This is the foundation of a courageous, playful and deeply integrative healing journey between you and your inner child.

During the workshop, we create a safe and nurturing space for your inner child to be seen, heard and witnessed in both their light and shadow, held in wholeness. You will learn tools and techniques to hold space for yourself, connect with your inner child, and build a lasting relationship of trust.

Inner child work is a complete, trauma-informed and deeply considerate modality. As it transforms your own life, the desire to share this work with others may naturally arise. When that calling comes, you are warmly welcomed into our practitioner pathway.

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="15"][vc_custom_heading text="Who Is Inner Child Practitioner Training For?" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="fadeInUp" css=""][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="15"][fancy-ul icon_type="font_icon" icon="icon-star" color="Accent-Color" alignment="left" spacing="default" link_style="default"]

Training to become an Inner Child Practitioner is suited to those who wish to:

  • deepen their personal journey of healing, transformation and self-understanding
  • learn a structured framework that expands their skills, tools and experience
  • receive support and guidance while embodying the workshop techniques
  • stay accountable to their own practice with mentoring and practitioner support
  • acknowledge their commitment through certification aligned with their values
  • make a heartfelt commitment to a transformative, experiential healing modality
[/fancy-ul][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row type="in_container" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" column_direction="default" column_direction_tablet="default" column_direction_phone="default" scene_position="center" bottom_padding="40" text_color="dark" text_align="left" row_border_radius="none" row_border_radius_applies="bg" row_position_desktop="default" row_position_tablet="inherit" row_position_phone="inherit" overflow="visible" overlay_strength="0.3" gradient_direction="left_to_right" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none" shape_type="" gradient_type="default"][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_tablet="inherit" column_padding_phone="inherit" column_padding_position="all" flex_gap_desktop="10px" column_element_direction_desktop="default" column_element_spacing="default" desktop_text_alignment="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_backdrop_filter="none" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" column_link_target="_self" column_position="default" gradient_direction="left_to_right" overlay_strength="0.3" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" animation_type="default" bg_image_animation="none" border_type="simple" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid"][vc_custom_heading text="Becoming a certified Inner Child Practitioner" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="fadeInUp" css=""][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="10"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

The Inner Council Practitioner Program is an experiential training process, rooted in an inner-child-led, trauma-informed, integrative approach, supporting practitioners to embody the work personally before offering it professionally. Practitioners demonstrate their ongoing relationship of trust with their inner child throughout the workshop and complete a 3-month mentoring process. This is required in order to ethically deliver workshops and mentor others.

After mentoring, you will complete the Practitioner Program, which focuses on the soft skills needed to support participants with confidence, enthusiasm, clarity and care. Upon completion, you will receive all documentation and certification required to:

  • run Inner Child Workshops
  • provide mentoring
  • integrate inner child work into your existing practice
[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="10"][vc_custom_heading text="Your Personal Inner Child Practice" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="fadeInUp" css=""][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="15"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

Certification involves a commitment to maintaining and deepening your own relationship with your inner child. Daily check-ins, journaling and recording interactions form a core part of ongoing personal development.

This inner work is essential. By tending to your own healing, you build the experience, empathy and grounded presence needed to hold space for others.

The Practitioner Program is delivered over two one-to-one sessions. However, training is only one part of the journey.

There is no strict timeline. The natural development of trust, integration and connection with your inner child may take between 3–6 months, depending on personal circumstances and how the practice weaves into your life.

Part of this journey is trusting:

  • yourself
  • your intuition
  • your inner child
  • the timing of your readiness

When alignment arrives, you will feel it clearly; there will be a moment of inner knowing that you are ready to offer the work to others.

This training is ideal for therapists, coaches, counsellors, holistic practitioners and energy workers, as well as those beginning their path who feel a sincere calling to support others.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row type="full_width_background" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" column_direction="default" column_direction_tablet="default" column_direction_phone="default" bg_color="#BC5F6A" scene_position="center" top_padding="30" bottom_padding="40" text_color="light" text_align="left" row_border_radius="none" row_border_radius_applies="bg" row_position_desktop="default" row_position_tablet="inherit" row_position_phone="inherit" overflow="visible" overlay_strength="0.3" gradient_direction="left_to_right" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none" shape_type="" gradient_type="default"][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_tablet="inherit" column_padding_phone="inherit" column_padding_position="all" flex_gap_desktop="10px" column_element_direction_desktop="default" column_element_spacing="default" desktop_text_alignment="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_backdrop_filter="none" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" column_link_target="_self" column_position="default" gradient_direction="left_to_right" overlay_strength="0.3" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" animation_type="default" bg_image_animation="none" border_type="simple" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid"][vc_custom_heading text="Frequently Asked Questions" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="fadeInUp" css=""][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="10"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

Do I need previous experience in therapy or healing to join? No. The program is open to anyone who has completed the Inner Child Workshop and feels a genuine calling to continue the work, either personally or professionally.

Will this integrate with my existing practice? Yes. Many practitioners blend Inner Child work with counselling, coaching, energy healing, somatic work and spiritual modalities. The framework is trauma-informed, flexible and complementary.

How do mentoring sessions work? You will meet one-to-one for personalised support, exploration and guidance. Mentoring helps you embody the work, deepen your connection with your inner child, and prepare to hold space for others.

How long will certification take? There is no set timeline. Most practitioners complete the process within 3–6 months, depending on personal integration and life commitments.

What happens after I’m certified? You will be able to facilitate workshops, mentor participants and integrate Inner Child work into your professional or personal offerings.

Is there support after certification? Yes. You will have continued access to support, resources and community.

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Extra-Color-3" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Janice - Licensed Clinical Social Worker in Private Practice"][vc_column_text]

Amy was superb and skilled at pulling out feelings and behaviors through active listening without blaming but simply naming the behaviors and what they mean to your current interactions or relationships.

font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="none"][vc_column_text]

Women gathering in circle is an ancient practice and artform that lives on within our DNA. I believe in the power of being in circle to witness, support and uplift each other. Having led and participated in women’s circles for over three years I have experienced first hand the truly sacred space and transformative power it holds. Connection, community and collaboration with like-minded and like-hearted souls are what sitting in circle with women have to offer. We have been doing this for millenia! Whilst some aspects of daily living and fast changing, uncertain global factors are moving in a direction away from connection, community and collaboration, I believe there is a calling to unite and remember the value of shared collective wisdom and support that these aspects bring; for our future as individuals and collectively.

This offering aligns with my values and beliefs in personal empowerment beginning with setting up a safe container where confidentiality, respect and gratitude are upheld. As a space holder for the group, a sacred space is maintained and you are a co-creator. This circle is yours and ours to co-create.

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="No Line" custom_height="30"][vc_custom_heading text="What to expect?" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="none"][vc_column_text]

Throughout the eight weeks, we will gather in circle for an hour together each week and you will experience a safe space to share, express and be present with yourself and others. You will meet and join other beautiful souls who feel called to be in circle too, enabling strong connections and a sense of community to be built. Learning from each other, sharing wisdom through honouring all aspects of yourself, combined with the exploration of a given theme, we embark on a journey in circle together.

What makes the circle space sacred is that it is free from judgement; however you show up in the moment, exactly as you are; no filters, prerequisites or experience necessary! In fact what makes a circle authentic is not knowing what’s going to come up because as a group we co-create this space together. Whilst there is a structure, theme and container, the content as such is unknown until the moment arrives. Honouring each woman’s voice, words, silences, thoughts and feelings; listening, affirming and receiving each other.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]

Each week we have a theme to consider and explore during the week leading up to our live call and on the call itself. You will have the opportunity to share how this theme has been showing up for you, as well as witnessing the other women in the group as they share their experiences too. A gentle reminder that what you put in, you shall receive in kindness, gratitude and appreciation! I understand that being in circle and feeling vulnerable is a natural part of the process, yet please don’t let this hinder or hold you back from giving yourself this opportunity to receive an authentic experience.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]

I believe in the gift of collaboration and collective support where you are celebrated, accepted and valued to be just who you are. This is so powerful and we all deserve to receive this, including you! There is a wealth of wisdom, healing and nourishment to be gained. And, it’s going to be fun! I would love for you to join me and experience being in circle. Whether you are new to women’s circles or have attended and participated in women’s circle, or any other type of circle work before, this is a timeless practice where you will always be learning and growing from new experiences and the dynamic of the group.

Time Zones may vary and it is my intention to make this as available as possible to those who wish to join, choosing the appropriate time that suits you. Initially the offering will be scheduled for Thursdays, GMT(London) 7pm-8pm and Thursdays, US Eastern Time 6pm-7pm.

All circle calls will be held on Zoom and due to the nature of being live together, recordings are not taking place. This allows for the authentic experience to be had and receive the benefits that being live together in circle provides. This is an experiential journey!

The investment is £85, which is due to be paid in full by September 29th by Paypal or UK bank transfer. An email will be sent to you when you reserve your place with all instructions on how to secure your seat in circle with payment in due course.

We deploy all efforts to protect the private nature of your personal information. Since we collect information about you using our website and through our email communication, we feel that it is important that you understand how we collect and use this information. The below summarises our personal information collection practices.

Personal Information Collection

All personal information collected by Amy Grist is done so exclusively with your consent, by means of a form posted on our website, an email attachment, a diagnostic telephone conversation or a physical document given on your arrival. No information is collected automatically.

Use of your Personal Information

The personal information collected is only used by our team for the purposes defined at the time of the collection or a use that complies with these purposes. Physical documents are stored safely and we do not share your information with any third parties.

As mentioned above, we use your personal information to appropriately process your appointment requests and present you with the information you need to access.

Sharing of your Personal Information

We will not, in any circumstances, share your personal information with other individuals or organizations without your permission, including public organizations, corporations or individuals, except when applicable by law. We do not sell, communicate or divulge your information to any mailing lists.

They complement and support all stages of Inner Child Work by illuminating patterns, emotions and subconscious threads that may be ready to integrate.

Inner Child cards touch the layers of our psyche with clarity and tenderness, often bringing forward:

  • insights into long-held behaviour patterns
  • recognition of conditioning or emotional loops
  • intuitive messages from the child self
  • moments of clarity that shift perspective instantly
  • threads linking past experiences to present challenges or breakthroughs

Like all healing work, the journey continues to unfold and these readings serve as supportive stepping stones along your path of transformation.

Your inner child, sometimes called the Primary Archetype, is the purest expression of who you are. This part of you holds your natural curiosity, innocence, creativity, and intuition. When we learn to connect with the inner child, it becomes a compassionate guide, helping us explore our subconscious, release old wounds, and move toward emotional, physical, and spiritual wellbeing.

Through a trusted relationship with your inner child, deeper wisdom and instinctive knowing begin to emerge. This connection allows us to explore the symbols and archetypes of the collective unconscious, giving meaning, value, and clarity to our life experiences.

  • build your first connection with your inner child
  • learn how to create a trusting and playful relationship

  • begin integrating insights, emotions, and memories gently and safely

Many of us carry childhood wounds, conditioning, or emotional imprints into adulthood. These past experiences can show up as:

  • repeated behaviour patterns
  • self-sabotage
  • low energy or emotional blocks
  • anxiety, insecurity or difficulty setting boundaries
  • beliefs that no longer serve us

Inner child work helps us identify and integrate these origins. With patience, dedication and support, the nervous system softens, trauma can release, and patterns begin to change. This is where deep transformation happens.

Inner child healing is recognised across psychology, psychotherapy and ancient spiritual traditions, from Tibetan Buddhism to Andean shamanism. It is a grounded, accessible and empowering approach that gently supports the mind, body and spirit.

  • break repetitive cycles

  • reconnect with the whole self

Inner Child Healing is offered through an inner-child-led, trauma-informed, integrative approach, creating a safe space to explore, heal and reconnect with the parts of you that hold memory, emotion and wisdom.

Inner Child Workshops are available:

  • One-on-one
  • in small groups
  • online sessions
  • in-person sessions

Throughout the workshop, you will be guided step-by-step to connect with your inner child through:

  • written reflection exercises
  • guided meditations
  • regressional and imaginal practices
  • gentle rebirthing techniques
  • shared discussion in a safe and supported space

The pace is individually tailored, with plenty of space for processing, questions, and integration.

Included in the Workshop

  • participant workbook
  • access to a private online portal
  • digital reference guides and practices
  • space to record notes and upload reflections

Once the workshop concludes, a period of integration is encouraged. Ongoing support is available through follow-up sessions, online or in-person, to offer feedback, introduce new techniques, and help deepen your practice.

heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Stefanie, United States"][vc_column_text][/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp" text_direction="default"]

"I had done some inner child work throughout the years. Never any formal inner child work like this workshop, just in general therapy sessions.

I learned quite a bit about each childhood stage and development. Amy's meditations were very powerful for accessing memories and creating a safe space for that and I see how important that safe space is for helping someone access traumatic memories. 

I loved Amy's energy and compassion and knowledge. Amy is very adept at guiding through the processes of inner child work and listening to the student and helping clarify difficult emotions."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Sheyna, United States"][vc_column_text][/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"I had an amazing experience with the Inner Child Workshop. Amy is incredible and really understands the work and gives out good energy. She truly made a difference in my view of life in a good way. After the first session I already felt a difference and the more sessions I had the better I felt and connected with my inner child. I am very glad and thankful I did this workshop and definitely will be recommending it to others. This truly is a life changing experience."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Emma, United States"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"The workshop provided a space to listen to my inner child, realizing the need to allow her space to do or say the things she always wished she could have, but also reminding her she is safe now and it's okay to not have to be in survival mode anymore.

It was very insightful. I've learned so much about myself and reflecting on my inner child journey."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Adina, United States"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"After numerous years in therapy, discussions about the concept of the inner child consistently arose. While I acknowledged its presence, forming a genuine connection remained a challenge. Despite attempting various techniques like writing to her, sustaining a meaningful relationship with my inner child proved to be difficult.

The workshop led by Amy provided me with a wonderful sense of security and comfort. Her serene disposition created an environment that put me at ease, offering ample room and time for me to express my thoughts and stories.

The guided meditations played a significant role in facilitating a stronger connection with my inner child. They stirred something within me that I now sense is constantly accessible. These meditations fostered a deeper bond with my inner child, reducing the sense of detachment I used to feel.

Initially unsure of what to anticipate, it wasn't until my last follow-up that I vocalized my recent state, leading me to truly comprehend the positive impact the workshop had on me. I found myself gradually forming a stronger bond with my inner child, a longing I've held for quite some time. I am profoundly appreciative of the opportunity this space and experience have given me."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Rita, UK"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"My initial intention from the workshop was healing childhood trauma. On reflection this goal was definitely achieved as I feel at peace & light hearted, something that I had always yearned for (away from the heaviness of the trauma). I no longer feel that unsettling unease. I have established a foundational baseline that I can use to carry on further.

The workshop has deepened my healing and my desire to go further into the practitioner's program, which I am doing. I am more certain & confident about my life & my purpose than ever before. I believe the deep healing has brought forth the parts of me that had still been stifled by past occurrences.

I really looked forward to my inner child sessions. It was great to be able to be in the comfort of my own home during the deep healing that occurred.

I never felt uncomfortable and was always given the space to think & feel what was going on. I felt safe & heard always."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Annie, Australia"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"I am now able to connect on a deeper level with my inner child and the workshop helped me put things into a better understanding and confirmation I was already on my journey with my inner child. 

I really enjoyed the workshop. Amy was so knowledgeable and had such empathy. Very patient and warm and I felt a sense of trust right from the beginning which I feel is important when sharing past experiences. The meditations were so powerful and I got a lot from them too."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Hodaya, United States"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"The online workshop was a great experience. I am very comfortable with learning and experiencing the wonderful practices that were shared, without a doubt, very powerful. As a practitioner, Amy is very gentle, soft, and patient. I felt very comfortable from the onset, finding it easier to talk about difficult and challenging things from my past. Amy creates and maintains a safe space of non-judgement, which was very supportive and I saw how much it helped my inner child too.

Smart, understanding and kind, Amy creates safety for people like me with deep trauma to feel comfortable and be vulnerable at their own pace and depths. The framework is very gentle and applicable to daily life. I took away tools and techniques to heal my heart so I don’t suffer with painful wounds anymore.

I feel like everything I lacked previously, has now been given to me in a tangible way. I am so grateful and would definitely recommend this work to everyone!"

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Lizzie, UK"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"I had understood the term inner child in the sense that we can all go into our child state of playfulness if we want to, but not aware of going into meditation and connecting on such a deep level. This is truly awesome.

The course exceeded any expectations that I had. I loved the meditations and being able to connect to my inner child now is such a joy. I felt guided to reparent my inner child, almost like I’m being prepared for something else.

I loved taking part in the online workshop. Amy is such a joy to work with. My inner child felt very safe during workshops."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Trish, Canada"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"I had NO IDEA how deeply some parts of my childhood, specifically while in the womb and as a toddler, affected my programming. I learned so much about where my behaviour comes from. I also learned so much about my mum and my dad and my childhood that I had no idea about. I can see the differences in my brother and I now. I understand myself better. I understand how to soothe myself better.

We did our work in person and I really appreciate that. Amy creates such a safe and comforting space to do the work. As much as there’s learning, there’s working through thoughts and concepts and Amy provides the space to do that with clarity and support. It was a beautiful experience."

[/vc_column_text][/toggle][toggle color="Default" heading_tag="default" heading_tag_functionality="default" title="Marina, UK"][vc_column_text css_animation="fadeInUp"]

"The workshop has provided me with an invaluable set of tools and techniques that help me to connect with my inner child, to return to being at one with my intuition, to hear and feel my heart louder and more clearly with every day that passes! It is a beautiful and powerful practice and I could not imagine doing it with anyone else but with Amy! She is an incredibly warm and welcoming person and we connected straight away.

During the workshop, Amy was able to readily offer me options and alternatives if something didn’t quite sit right with me straight away and that was very beneficial to me. The format and the content of the workshop flowed so naturally, and each session absolutely flew by.

If your heart has led you to the workshop, listen to it!"

After completing the Inner Child Workshop, the following weeks and months become a vital stage of your integration journey. This is where your relationship with your Inner Child deepens. It’s a time of digesting the material, reflecting on your experiences, and weaving the tools you’ve learned into your daily life.

Integration requires patience, gentleness and consistency. Mentoring offers a supportive, guided container to nurture this connection and help you navigate the shifts, openings and insights that continue to arise.

Inner Child Mentoring is ideal for anyone who has completed the Inner Child Workshop and feels ready to deepen the journey. It may resonate with you if:

  • you want continued support while integrating the workshop
  • you feel emotional or energetic shifts and want guidance processing them
  • old patterns or memories are resurfacing and you’d like clarity on their meaning
  • you’re seeking accountability and a safe space to stay connected to the work
  • you want to strengthen trust, dialogue and playfulness with your Inner Child
  • you sense deeper layers of healing ready to unfold
  • you desire companionship, grounding and reassurance along your path
  • you value a long-term relationship with your inner world, nurtured with care

Mentoring meets you exactly where you are, honouring your rhythm, your readiness, and your inner landscape.

Mentoring sessions are gentle, trauma-informed, and tailored to your personal journey. Sessions can be weekly or every two weeks, depending on what best supports your integration.

Together, we explore:

  • insights, memories or emotions arising from your Inner Child practice
  • limiting beliefs and subconscious patterns ready to be rewired
  • hidden, forgotten or suppressed aspects of the child self
  • past wounds, trauma imprints, attachment patterns or emotional blocks
  • relationship dynamics connected to childhood conditioning
  • nervous system responses, resistance and protective parts
  • your ongoing connection and communication with your Inner Child

Between sessions, if something meaningful arises, you’re invited to share it. Support and guidance are available throughout the process as part of holding the integrity of your inner work.

As you continue nurturing the relationship with your Inner Child, you may experience:

  • deeper emotional clarity and self-awareness
  • a calmer, more regulated nervous system
  • softened anxiety, fear or self-doubt
  • renewed intuition, creativity and inner wisdom
  • healthier communication and boundaries
  • integration of old memories and emotional patterns
  • increased self-compassion and inner safety
  • conscious, balanced relationship dynamics
  • greater confidence to express your authentic self
  • a sense of inner harmony, belonging and wholeness

Mentoring supports these shifts to unfold gently and sustainably, honouring your pace and celebrating your growth.

Mentoring offers the opportunity to revisit and deepen the Inner Child meditation techniques learned in the workshop. Together, we may explore:

  • guided regressions
  • imaginal dialogues
  • somatic awareness practices
  • emotional release techniques
  • ancestral and generational healing threads

Letting go of long-held beliefs, emotions and protective strategies requires tenderness. Mentoring creates the safety needed to peel back layers of conditioning and automatic responses, allowing healing to unfold naturally.

Reiki is an ancient healing system founded by Dr. Mikao Usui. In Japanese, Rei translates to “Universal Spirit” or “Essence,” and Ki means “Life Energy” — also known as Chi in Eastern traditions. Together, Rei-ki expresses the universal life force energy that surrounds us, moves through us, and is woven into all of existence.

Reiki comes from a traditional Tibetan Buddhist lineage, once passed down orally from master to student and now shared through attunements, teachings and dedicated practice.

Although many modern variations exist, the essence of Reiki remains unchanged: when we open to the flow of universal life energy, healing becomes accessible on every level of our being.

Reiki is not tied to religion, it is a universal, inclusive practice that harmonises beautifully with any spiritual or holistic path.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row type="in_container" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" column_direction="default" column_direction_tablet="default" column_direction_phone="default" scene_position="center" top_padding="30" text_color="dark" text_align="left" row_border_radius="none" row_border_radius_applies="bg" row_position_desktop="default" row_position_tablet="inherit" row_position_phone="inherit" overflow="visible" overlay_strength="0.3" gradient_direction="left_to_right" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none" shape_type="" gradient_type="default"][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_tablet="inherit" column_padding_phone="inherit" column_padding_position="all" flex_gap_desktop="10px" column_element_direction_desktop="default" column_element_spacing="default" desktop_text_alignment="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_backdrop_filter="none" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" column_link_target="_self" column_position="default" gradient_direction="left_to_right" overlay_strength="0.3" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" animation_type="default" bg_image_animation="none" border_type="simple" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid"][vc_custom_heading text="How Reiki Supports You" use_theme_fonts="yes" css_animation="fadeInUp" css=""][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

Reiki meets you exactly where you are. Because the universal life force is unconditional love, Reiki is entirely safe to receive and requires only your willingness to rest, soften and trust the process.

In the pace and pressure of modern living, many of us experience imbalance; emotionally, mentally, physically and spiritually. Reiki gently supports the natural intelligence of the body by bringing coherence, balance and ease to your energy system.

The more Reiki is practised and received, the more deeply your system integrates harmony and self-healing. The effects may be subtle or profound, both are equally valid, both are healing.

[/vc_column_text][fancy-ul icon_type="font_icon" icon="icon-star" color="Accent-Color" alignment="left" spacing="default" link_style="default"]

Reiki can support:

  • emotional, mental, physical and spiritual balancing
  • restoring and expanding your life force energy
  • deep relaxation and nervous system regulation
  • alignment with your Higher Self and inner wisdom
  • strengthening the body’s natural healing processes
  • supporting ongoing medical or therapeutic treatments
  • boosting immunity and energetic vitality
  • healing for yourself, loved ones and even animals
  • connection, compassion and inner peace

Reiki practitioners have been attuned and trained to channel this energy through sacred symbols and lineage teachings.

I offer Reiki Level 1 and Level 2 courses, following the Usui natural healing method. These courses are available online via Zoom and provide the foundational understanding, attunements and practices needed to begin or deepen your Reiki journey.

I also gladly offer distance Reiki healing. If you would like to receive Reiki, or request Reiki for a loved one, friend or pet, I would be honoured to support you.

Distance Reiki sessions can be arranged:

  • at a specific time, or within an agreed timeframe
  • with just a full name, location and (optional) photograph
  • for adults, children and animals

The process typically takes about a week from first contact to the scheduled session.

A unique, integrated path for Inner Child healing

Inner Child Reiki is a special adaptation of the traditional Reiki 1 course, weaving in practices that support you in giving and receiving Reiki directly with your Inner Child. This course is offered one-to-one and exclusively for those who have completed the Inner Council Inner Child Workshop.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

What Is Inner Child Reiki?

When we turn inward, the healing potential of Reiki awakens. It enhances intuition, emotional clarity and personal empowerment while supporting harmony across the energy system.

Your Inner Child is pure love; open, intuitive, joyful and deeply aligned with Reiki’s purpose of restoring balance within. Both practices recognise healing as a return to wholeness.

As Reiki Channels, we can direct loving energy toward our Inner Child to:

  • soothe emotional wounds
  • restore balance to forgotten or hidden parts
  • clear imbalances from memories and past experiences
  • cultivate compassion, safety and acceptance
  • strengthen the relationship between the inner parent and inner child

Building trust with your Inner Child is foundational to this work. Through consistent, loving presence, your inner child experiences being truly seen, held and valued.

When we trust the Reiki process, we trust that healing unfolds in the way that serves our highest good. In this union, Reiki and Inner Child Work become deeply intertwined, expanding inner trust, reconnecting us to Spirit, and restoring the wholeness that is already within us.

Time & Costs

Inner Child Reiki Level 1 includes:

  • two sessions (120–150 minutes each), approx. 5 hours total

What happens during a Reiki session?

In a Reiki session, you simply relax and receive. I channel universal life energy to support balance in your emotional, mental, physical and spiritual system. You may feel warmth, tingling, calm, emotion release, or simply deep rest; each experience is unique and perfect for your needs.

Is Reiki safe?

Yes. Reiki is a gentle, non-invasive healing modality rooted in unconditional love. It is safe for all ages, supportive alongside medical treatment, and deeply beneficial for emotional, physical and spiritual wellbeing.

What is distance Reiki and how does it work?

Distance Reiki allows healing energy to be sent across any distance using the traditional Reiki symbols. Energy is not limited by time or space, making distance sessions just as effective as in-person sessions. All I need is a name, location and optional photo.

Do I need experience to learn Reiki?

No experience is needed. Reiki Level 1 is suitable for complete beginners. You’ll receive attunements, guided practice, and the tools needed to begin working with Reiki for yourself, loved ones and your environment.

What’s the difference between Reiki Level 1 and Level 2?

  • Reiki Level 1 focuses on self-healing and learning to channel Reiki through touch.
  • Reiki Level 2 deepens your practice, introducing sacred symbols, distance healing, and the ability to work with others.
You are welcome to enquire about which level is right for you.

What is Inner Child Reiki?

Inner Child Reiki is a unique adaptation of Reiki 1 that incorporates direct work with your Inner Child. You’ll learn how to offer Reiki to your inner child, bring healing into memories, and strengthen your inner parent–child connection. This course is available one-to-one for those who have completed the Inner Child Workshop.

Can Reiki be sent to pets or animals?

Yes. Reiki is deeply supportive for animals and can be offered through distance healing. It is gentle, safe and often very calming for pets.

How long is a distance Reiki session?

A distance session is typically arranged within a specific time window. The process usually takes about a week from initial contact to the scheduled session. You are welcome to rest or meditate during the session, though it is not required.

How do I book a session or course?

You can enquire directly using the link below. Integration is the process of bringing all aspects of yourself into harmony; mind, body, emotions and spirit. It is a lifelong journey of returning to wholeness, supported by practice, dedication, presence and compassion.

Through integration, we cultivate a grounded foundation within ourselves. We learn to meet life’s experiences with awareness, to soften old patterns, and to reconnect with our authentic centre. It is a holistic approach to healing that honours the fullness of who we are.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row type="in_container" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" column_direction="default" column_direction_tablet="default" column_direction_phone="default" scene_position="center" top_padding="30" text_color="dark" text_align="left" row_border_radius="none" row_border_radius_applies="bg" overflow="visible" overlay_strength="0.3" gradient_direction="left_to_right" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none" gradient_type="default" shape_type=""][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_tablet="inherit" column_padding_phone="inherit" column_padding_position="all" column_element_direction_desktop="default" column_element_spacing="default" desktop_text_alignment="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_backdrop_filter="none" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" column_link_target="_self" column_position="default" gradient_direction="left_to_right" overlay_strength="0.3" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" animation_type="default" bg_image_animation="none" border_type="simple" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid"][vc_custom_heading text="A Path Toward Wholeness" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

Throughout our lifetime, we collect beliefs, conditioning, habit patterns and emotional imprints. These can manifest as challenges, creative blocks, limiting behaviours or difficulties in relationships.

Integration work gently invites us to explore and heal these deeper layers, not from a place of fixing, but from understanding, compassion and conscious choice.

This work supports you in:

  • identifying and healing trauma imprints
  • softening long-held patterns and emotional reactions
  • cultivating inner clarity and emotional balance
  • reconnecting with your intuition and inner authority
  • reclaiming the potential that has always been within you
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row type="in_container" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" column_direction="default" column_direction_tablet="default" column_direction_phone="default" scene_position="center" top_padding="30" bottom_padding="20" text_color="dark" text_align="left" row_border_radius="none" row_border_radius_applies="bg" overflow="visible" overlay_strength="0.3" gradient_direction="left_to_right" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none" gradient_type="default" shape_type=""][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_tablet="inherit" column_padding_phone="inherit" column_padding_position="all" column_element_direction_desktop="default" column_element_spacing="default" desktop_text_alignment="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_backdrop_filter="none" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" column_link_target="_self" column_position="default" gradient_direction="left_to_right" overlay_strength="0.3" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" animation_type="default" bg_image_animation="none" border_type="simple" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid"][vc_custom_heading text="A Space to Explore, Heal and Transform" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

I invite you to open and explore the deeper components of your inner world in a safe, grounded and supportive space. Integration work offers room for:

  • profound realisations
  • emotional release
  • expanded self-awareness
  • meaningful transformation

Through guided enquiry and intuitive support, we direct intention toward the areas of your life, behaviour or inner landscape that feel ready for adjustment, liberation or healing.

This is deep work, gentle yet powerful, weaving through the physical, emotional and spiritual aspects of Self.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row type="full_width_background" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" column_direction="default" column_direction_tablet="default" column_direction_phone="default" bg_color="#E3A6A1" scene_position="center" top_padding="30" bottom_padding="50" text_color="light" text_align="left" row_border_radius="none" row_border_radius_applies="bg" overflow="visible" overlay_strength="0.3" gradient_direction="left_to_right" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none" gradient_type="default" shape_type=""][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_tablet="inherit" column_padding_phone="inherit" column_padding_position="all" column_element_direction_desktop="default" column_element_spacing="default" desktop_text_alignment="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_backdrop_filter="none" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" column_link_target="_self" column_position="default" gradient_direction="left_to_right" overlay_strength="0.3" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" animation_type="default" bg_image_animation="none" border_type="simple" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid"][vc_custom_heading text="Listening to the Inner Landscape" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

Integration begins with listening. When we turn inward with honesty and curiosity, we meet the parts of ourselves that long to be acknowledged, soothed or understood.

This process may involve:

  • meeting parts of yourself that have been hidden or rejected
  • recognising protective patterns and understanding their origins
  • learning to love the parts of you that feel difficult to embrace
  • allowing space for shadow work, compassion and acceptance
  • developing the courage to be fully expressed and present

Integration is not always about releasing or “getting rid” of anything. Often, the transformation lies in softening, accepting, and inviting love into the spaces we once resisted.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row type="in_container" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" column_direction="default" column_direction_tablet="default" column_direction_phone="default" scene_position="center" top_padding="30" text_color="dark" text_align="left" row_border_radius="none" row_border_radius_applies="bg" overflow="visible" overlay_strength="0.3" gradient_direction="left_to_right" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none" gradient_type="default" shape_type=""][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_tablet="inherit" column_padding_phone="inherit" column_padding_position="all" column_element_direction_desktop="default" column_element_spacing="default" desktop_text_alignment="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_backdrop_filter="none" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" column_link_target="_self" column_position="default" gradient_direction="left_to_right" overlay_strength="0.3" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" animation_type="default" bg_image_animation="none" border_type="simple" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid"][vc_custom_heading text="Opening to Change" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

The willingness to change, even subtly, is the first step toward transformation. When we allow honest reflection on the relationships we have with ourselves, others and the world, we begin to see what truly serves us.

This can be confronting at times, but it is also deeply liberating. With kindness and self-recognition, we gain the clarity needed to move beyond:

  • destructive habits
  • repetitive thoughts
  • emotional blocks
  • outdated beliefs

A Practice Rooted in My Experience

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

I have spent over a thousand hours in silent meditation retreats, where days often begin at 4am and include up to 11 hours of meditation. I have also managed retreats of up to 100 students, offering guidance, answering questions, and supporting participants through their inner journeys with care and clarity.

As a meditation guide, I share these practices with deep reverence. I hold space for others to feel comfortable, confident and safe as they explore their inner world through meditation.

Consider a Sacred Meditative Space

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

When I imagine a sacred space, I am drawn to somewhere warm, homely, inviting and safe, a place where I can be my true, authentic self. A place of unconditional acceptance, presence and openness.

For many, this sacred space is imagined as something external, and it can be, but I invite you to journey inward with me, to discover the sacredness that already exists within you.

Your inner sanctuary is a doorway into the multidimensional layers of your being, where intuition, inner wisdom and spiritual presence reside. Through meditation, we create a bridge between the conscious mind and the subconscious, opening access to a rich internal landscape full of insight, clarity and possibility.

Whether you’re new to meditation or have been practising for years, each journey inward is unique. It may feel colourful, sensory, peaceful, still, emotional or deeply informative.

There is no right way. Only your way.

Every time you go within, a new experience is waiting to unfold.

Meditation in Practice

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="accent-color" animate="yes"][vc_column_text css_animation="none" css="" text_direction="default"]

Meditation is foundational in supporting nervous system regulation and emotional, physical and mental wellbeing. Mindfulness meditation, which uses the breath as an anchor, cultivates presence and helps you self-regulate with more ease.

In my own practice and in the work I share, meditation supports:

  • emotional and nervous system regulation
  • grounding and centring
  • reduced stress and overwhelm
  • increased clarity and stillness
  • intuitive awareness
  • self-soothing and inner safety
  • connection to the Inner Child

Find a comfortable position. Soften distractions. Gently close your eyes.

Due to early conditioning, learned behaviours and adaptive patterns formed in childhood, many of us move through life unaware of the subconscious beliefs that shape how we think, feel and respond. We often live on autopilot, repeating familiar cycles and coping mechanisms that once kept us safe, accepted and loved.

As adults, we no longer need these survival strategies, yet reprogramming the patterns that limit our authenticity requires care, awareness and support.

Mindset and Wellbeing Coaching offers a space to uncover and release those patterns  creating alignment between your mind, body, emotions and spirit.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

Healing From Within

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="extra-color-1" animate="yes" custom_line_width="300"][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

Healing unfolds on many levels and at many stages of life. Creating a safe and compassionate space for the parts of us that are ready to integrate is central to this journey.

I believe the answers we seek already exist within us; we simply need a way to access them. Through guided coaching, reflection and mindfulness-based practices, we tap into deeper layers of awareness and reconnect with the innate wisdom at the core of our being.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

About My Approach

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="extra-color-1" animate="yes" custom_line_width="300"][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

As a certified Mindfulness Coach, Wellbeing Practitioner and Mentor, I provide a grounded, nurturing space to explore the areas of life where you’re facing challenge or change.

Drawing from both training and lived experience, I weave together approaches including:

  • Neuro-linguistic programming (NLP)
  • Reparenting and inner child integration
  • Generational and ancestral healing
  • Reframing and belief deconditioning
  • Conscious relationship dynamics and communication

These tools support you in releasing outdated habits and restoring alignment with your true, authentic self; the soul you came here to be.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

Does This Resonate With You?

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="extra-color-1" animate="yes" custom_line_width="300"][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

You may feel drawn to this work if:

  • You value meaningful relationships and wish to create more harmony and balance within them.
  • You appear confident but sense that your true authenticity isn’t fully expressed.
  • You wish to deepen your experience of love, for yourself and others, in ways that feel nurturing, conscious and fulfilling.
  • Your heart, body, mind and soul feel ready to awaken more fully to their vitality and purpose.

Through this coaching journey, I’ll support you in releasing imbalances across all aspects of self; physical, emotional, mental and spiritual. This includes past wounds, outdated beliefs, and unhelpful behavioural loops.

As you reclaim your inner balance, relationships begin to flow more harmoniously, self-confidence blossoms, and love is both given and received with greater authenticity.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

What You’ll Gain

[/vc_column_text][divider line_type="Small Line" line_alignment="default" line_thickness="2" divider_color="extra-color-1" animate="yes" custom_line_width="300"][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

Mindset and Wellbeing Coaching invites growth through awareness and gentle transformation. As you integrate this work, you may begin to notice:

  • A clearer, calmer state of mind and improved emotional regulation
  • Stronger boundaries and healthier communication in relationships
  • Greater self-confidence and connection with your authentic voice
  • Deeper compassion for yourself and others
  • Freedom from repetitive thought and behaviour patterns
  • An increased sense of energy, creativity and life purpose
  • Everyday wellbeing practices that sustain balance and clarity

Each person’s experience is unique; the most profound changes often unfold quietly, in the space where awareness meets self-acceptance.

How is Mindset and Wellbeing Coaching different from therapy? Coaching is future-focused and solution-oriented, guiding you to create practical changes and new perspectives. While we may gently acknowledge past experiences, the focus is on awareness, integration and forward movement.

How many sessions will I need? Many clients begin with three to six sessions, though this varies depending on your goals and pace. You can book sessions according to what is appropriate for your needs after your discovery call.

Are sessions online or in person? The majority of sessions are available online and face-to-face where possible, depending on your location (UK based). Both options are held in a safe, confidential and supportive environment.

Do I need any previous experience with meditation or self-development? Not at all. Whether you’re brand new to this work or have years of practice, the sessions meet you exactly where you are.

From an early age I was an active child exploring the boundaries of flexibility and the desire to express myself through movement, dance, gymnastics, expanding to drama performances on stage in adolescence. I tapped into many rhythms, expressions and styles before settling into a yin yoga based practice that is gentle, restorative and nurturing, drawing on inspiration from Tai Chi, meditation and breathwork.

A desire in me to share this practice naturally arose and I am grateful to witness its unfolding and share with the beautiful souls I’ve met along the journey so far.

My personal yoga practice has led me on a journey of transformation and continues to teach me lessons that contribute to the positive change in who I am and becoming. Movement is soulful, and as an individual who seeks deep connection with myself and others, I find peace and joy in moments of self and shared growth.

Providing one to one and small groups sessions I encourage heart opening trust with oneself during our time together. Guiding and holding space for one to connect with their own rhythm I provide support for individual needs, whilst considering and bringing balance in group dynamics.

Guiding myself through intuitive led processes and practices I come from a place of openness, creativity and compassion. This is woven into movement and my only desire is for a shared authentic experience together.

Yoga is an integral part of my self-care routine and each week I just breathe and let Amy take me on a relaxing, yet recharging journey to myself!

So far, I have taken part in about 20 online yoga classes with Amy and each time has been special. I am not always able to join “real-time” because of the time zone difference and work commitments, so I treasure the ability to access the recordings in “my-time”. Either way, it is magical to receive exactly what I need when I need it, whether a physical challenge, a message, an emotional release, or a revelation.

With a calming voice, clear directions and a joyous twinkle in her eye, Amy suspends time and guides the class from her heart… from the intuitive intention setting at the start, through the fun warm up and asanas, to the most delicious shavasana at the end!

Thank you, Amy! I look forward to so much more to come.

Amy is an excellent teacher and guide. I attended her online classes which always began with an explanation of what we would be focusing on that day. I was not sure how online yoga classes would work but I needn’t of worried. Amy is attentive, very caring, calm and fully at ease with this medium.

Being a more mature lady I found I was unable to do some positions (weakness in wrists and knees). Amy is very understanding and supportive, offering alternative positions that I could do. Finished each class feeling relaxed and energised.

[vc_row type="in_container" full_screen_row_position="middle" column_margin="default" scene_position="center" text_color="dark" text_align="left" overlay_strength="0.3" shape_divider_position="bottom" bg_image_animation="none"][vc_column column_padding="no-extra-padding" column_padding_position="all" background_color_opacity="1" background_hover_color_opacity="1" column_link_target="_self" column_shadow="none" column_border_radius="none" width="1/1" tablet_width_inherit="default" tablet_text_alignment="default" phone_text_alignment="default" overlay_strength="0.3" column_border_width="none" column_border_style="solid" bg_image_animation="none"][vc_column_text]Capturing life through a lens delves into the multifaceted perspectives one experiences and can subsequently share through a still representation. Moments that encapsulate a feeling, invoke emotion and express authenticity is a form of honouring life as it unfolds, often without words.

As a child I became interested in what could be achieved with a click of a button. With traditional roll film, the anticipation of waiting to see photographs was part of the process, which has now shortened to seconds. I remember using my mum's Canon at family events, walks in nature and amusing myself in the garden snapping away at flowers, bees and butterflies.

Buying my own Canon DSLR was an opportunity to expand upon my interest and begin to explore the deeper workings of the view I perceived through my eyes, to the image I captured by camera.

Travelling long term in South America brought a new dynamic to photography for me; exotic, wild landscapes, dramatic city scenes, festivals of colours, light and faces among faces, animals, birds and wildlife, discovering them all for the first time and building a collection of images that could speak the words I could not.
Immersing myself in cultures, language and nature, a natural development in photographic expression unfolded. I thoroughly enjoy the journey; from inspiration, composition, capture, edit and finished piece.
I feel most at home in nature; standing still a hilltop, breathing in mountains, jungle, coastal, or deserted landscapes; macros of wildflowers, insects and plant life.

Complimenting my own personal development and experience in the areas of holistic intuitive led therapies, I have had the pleasure of photographing people in such unique and authentic settings. Photoshoots for self empowering and sustainable projects, retreat centres, and local family businesses who openly share vulnerability, healing and transformation with transparency, whilst honouring the sacredness of the work they do. I perceive the role of the photographer also to hold space; sensing intuitively the boundaries which one can work in to capture the essence, respecting values and traditions that each opportunity presents.

Receiving invitations to create and witness moments that represent a dream being realised, projects and events close to people's hearts is an honour and a responsibility I take seriously.
Providing a platform through images is a gift I am passionate in sharing. I warmly invite you to spend some time with me in the Gallery.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
